title: Fellowship Program
about: The Lalor Foundation's Fellowship Program awards fellowships to nonprofit research institutions for basic postdoctoral research in mammalian reproductive biology related to the regulation of fertility. Applications, including four letters, are submitted online.
requirements: Any nonprofit research institution, such as a university or medical research center, may apply; proof of nonprofit status is required
Applicants in their final year of doctoral study must expect to receive their degree in the year they apply
Four letters are required: two independent expert reviews, one letter of reference and one letter of support from the proposed sponsor/mentor

upskill.name: AI for Research & Academic Productivity
why: "basic postdoctoral research in mammalian reproductive biology" → objective "Use AI to support literature exploration, academic reading, information organization, research planning, and knowledge synthesis"
"two independent expert reviews" of the research → objective "Summarize and compare scholarly materials while identifying ... potential research gaps"
